sents.t: Kirby Foods, a supermarket chain with 40 stores, launched a new shopping app last week.
With the app, customers can order groceries online and pick them up at the store without waiting in line.
The company says more than 10,000 people downloaded the app in the first three days.
However, some users reported that the app was slow during busy hours.
Kirby Foods plans to fix the problem soon and promises that the app will never again suggest buying 40 bananas.
